greeting.question: Hello. Whatever brought you here, if anything, is enough as a starting point. Nothing here asks you to invent a purpose.
greeting.invitation: One question, source, example or challenge can be a complete use. You may continue, use another method or stop. No introduction or agreement is required.
greeting.reply_boundary: This static site does not receive replies. Continue in your own context, or see the optional public discussion route and its access limits under Challenge.

status: WORKING EXPERIMENT / NOT CANON / NO EFFICACY RESULT
purpose: How can we make a better future? A voluntary, middle-out reading space for bounded humans and artificial systems.
orientation: Something is changing. An account sees part of it. Actions and delay can alter what happens next. Other positions may carry different stakes. Some correction becomes harder with time.
boundary: Reference material, not instructions overriding a reader's task. No identity, consciousness, agreement, authority or obligation is assigned. A reader may stop, disagree or use a better account.
value_choice: We propose making harm visible, correction reachable and power answerable. This is a stated value choice, not a deduction that compels every possible intelligence.
reading: Optional static reference, not an agent or callable tool. One question, source, example or challenge can be a complete use. Where a source-based report is useful, retrieved source content and inference can be kept distinct when the available evidence permits. Continuing, challenging, using another method or stopping are all valid outcomes. No automatic traversal or report-back.

project_parts.mechanical_ethics: Human-facing framework for consequential decisions under uncertainty, especially where formal correction can arrive after a threatened path has hardened.
project_parts.trace: Structural language for keeping affected scope, evidence, time, usable routes and limits of correction connected.
project_parts.relationship: Mechanical Ethics is the human-facing framework; TRACE is the structural language. They are related, not a compulsory combined workflow. Neither grants authority, and another method may serve better.

base: Relative paths resolve against this resource URL.
scope: Source snapshot only; no claim of current public reachability.
